notes: One clipboard for every app: Sym+V pastes (text fields, Terminal, Editor); C in the Authenticator copies the code. Sym+S keyboard shortcuts, terminal bell, toasts, Docker SSH / web links, Se
Fixes updates over Wi-Fi stopping with a watchdog reset while the new image was written. A Tab5 on 0.3.3 or 0.4.0 still updates with its old installer: install 0.4.1 once by cable from this
Command palette: Sym+Space finds any app or command. Sym+I shows battery, memory, network and CPU over any app. Tapping Wi-Fi, battery or the clock in the top bar opens that part of Settings
The camera works again (WireGuard and 2FA QR codes).
Fixes 0.3.1 running out of memory: update checks, REST, SSH, the camera and new 2FA vaults work again. Known issue: the camera doesn't start (fixed in 0.3.3).
Updates over Wi-Fi install reliably; WireGuard no longer restarts the Tab5 on connect. Known issue: runs out of memory (fixed in 0.3.2).
File Sharing: add and remove files on the SD card from a browser (Settings > File Sharing). Known issue: the camera doesn't start (fixed in 0.3.3).
Screen no longer flashes during updates; Settings shows the exact build; install / rollback reported. Known issue: the camera doesn't start (fixed in 0.3.3).
New Cricket app: ESPNcricinfo live scores, results by date, scorecards.
ADS-B: OpenStreetMap map under the radar (M toggles it).
